tldr: SpaceX achieved a significant milestone by successfully catching its Starship rocket with its 'Mechazilla' launch tower after orbit.
Global health authorities have indicated that the United States has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated.
A nationwide FAA ground stop for flights in the United States was attributed to an equipment issue during a telecommunications network upgrade.

market.why: Equity markets closed lower, with both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite declining, amidst turbulence in the AI trade sector and ongoing leadership challenges at Nvidia.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose on Friday, driven by October's producer price index data which showed higher wholesale prices, leading to increased expectations of a potential Federal Reserve rate hike.

vix.why: The VIX, an index of market volatility, increased, reflecting a general unease in the equity markets as they experienced declines.

mortgage.why: The weekly 30-year fixed mortgage rate, released on November 12, decreased slightly. The provided articles do not offer a specific reason for this particular weekly movement, though mortgage rates generally track trends in the 10-year Treasury yield over several days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: SpaceX successfully executed the first "chopstick" catch of its Starship rocket with the "Mechazilla" launch and catch tower after its Flight 15 orbital mission.
A court has denied a motion to dismiss a price-fixing case involving DRAM, allowing the lawsuit against companies like Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to proceed.
Security researchers have found that 'Lovable apps' exposed passport details and over 200,000 private messages, highlighting significant data vulnerabilities.

world.summary: Iran launched a drone attack targeting a US military base in Bahrain, marking the second such incident in three days amid a standoff with the US over the Strait of Hormuz.
Families in Gaza are now able to bury the remains of 69 Palestinians that have been recovered in the northern part of the region, after being trapped under rubble for years.
Aid agencies are struggling to provide essential services, including food, medical care, and shelter, to more than 50,000 Ethiopian refugees in Kenya.
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has stated that restrictions on SpaceX's Starshield services are hindering Ukraine's defense against Russia's energy attacks.

us.summary: A nationwide ground stop for flights in the United States was caused by an "equipment issue" during a contractor's upgrade to an older telecommunications system at a remote FAA facility, according to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy.
New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family a year ago, with initial outcomes showing what has worked and what has not in its implementation.
The Port of New Orleans has filed a $1 million lawsuit requesting the seizure and sale of a tanker involved in a collision with a cruise ship that resulted in over 30 injuries.

science.summary: Global health authorities, specifically researchers with knowledge of the Pan American Health Organization's deliberations, state that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status.
New guidelines designed to address the U.S. organ shortage through a retrieval procedure that maintains blood flow to organs are being met with ethical concerns from bioethicists.

weekly_recap: This week saw significant developments across several fronts. Early in the week, reports indicated a decrease in homelessness in the U.S. for the second consecutive year, while Israel's president selected Gadi Eisenkot to attempt forming a new government. Nvidia faced an internal investigation regarding its CEO, which impacted the company's stock, and France accused Iran of cyberattacks. US-led talks regarding the Russia-Ukraine conflict were described as productive, though Ukraine later reported new disruptions to its Starlink service. California voters rejected a proposal for a billionaire wealth tax, and Spain experienced a general strike over housing costs. Towards the end of the week, global Microsoft services, including Teams and Outlook, experienced a widespread outage. The 10-year Treasury yield rose on Friday following producer price index data, fueling expectations of a potential Federal Reserve rate hike. The week concluded with Microsoft services being fully restored and a nationwide FAA ground stop lifted, attributed to outdated equipment.
